question: Can a known target request reduce the observed target-versus-occluder ownership ambiguity, without per-test GT selectors?
bounded_approach: One possible future source-only diagnostic is generic text-conditioned detection for an inference-known target category, then GT-free association to the original initializer box and existing SAM2.1 box-prompt segmentation. This is feasibility research, not a chosen architecture/candidate or authorization to run.

official_remote_artifacts.duplicate_variant: pytorch_model.bin691,914,602B exists; no need to treat both formats as required. This review fetched neither.
official_remote_artifacts.processor_files: config/preprocessor/tokenizer/vocab/special-token files are additional small artifacts. Existing model.safetensors includes image/text model weights; a future local snapshot must bind all required files and forbid silent network fallback.
official_remote_artifacts.licenses: Official code and HF tiny card list Apache2.0; no license reinterpretation or new terms acceptance performed.

local_read_only_runtime_inventory.weight_inventory_limit: No GroundingDINO/GroundedSAM/SAM3 matching weight filenames found in the bounded known HF cache and prior DINO-asset roots searched. This is not an all-filesystem absence claim.
local_read_only_runtime_inventory.compatibility_inference: Existing SAM21 Python/Torch/torchvision versions meet the combined-demo documented version floor. Extra HF dependencies are not in that frozen SAM venv. The main environment has HF implementation source, but imports/dependencies/kernel path and joint execution were not tested. A future separate environment/process integration is possible in principle; preserve sealed runtime unchanged until a new protocol.
local_read_only_runtime_inventory.resources: New tiny weight artifact is about689MB plus small processor files; the existing SAM21 weight is already local. Combined activation memory, 10GB GPU fit, latency and throughput are unmeasured. No numerical runtime promise is made.

inference_target_request_and_public_fair.user_pallet: The user-known constant category pallet can be specified before any image/GT is inspected. A fixed generic pallet request is legitimate inference input; picking per-test wording/class from the hidden GT, current errors or desired output is not.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.publicYCB_category_free_option: Freeze one complete published YCB category ontology, wording/order and deterministic batching globally, then run the same text set on every source image. Associate detections to the original q8-derived box using only input geometry and predicted outputs. Do not choose only the current target GT name, objectID, mask or best-GT-overlap detection.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.ontology_length: Verify tokenized total against the model text-length limit before source inference; if batching is needed, fix identical ontology chunks/order for all images before reading results. No score-driven synonym/description or per-frame prompt search.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.publicYCB_class_provided_option: Alternatively the request may explicitly provide a target class for every inference, but that is a declared category-conditioned benchmark, separate from the old class-free protocol. It must not be presented as information that the old initializer supplied.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.association_limit: An ALL-category detector plus qbox is not an oracle for intended instance. Occluder detections can overlap the initial box more than a partly visible target, and repeated same-class objects remain ambiguous. A future association rule/ties/no-match policy must be frozen from available inputs, not GT; report wrong-instance/no-match separately.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.no_detection: No class detection or unreliable association is UNKNOWN/not-grounded, not proof of covered/external/self absence. Fully occluded targets may have no visible detection even though their semantic reference exists.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.no_query_change: Keep original q8/L/native order and evaluation locations. A detector box may be a separately declared segmentation prompt, not a reason to recenter queries, change r, or select different crops/GT targets.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.SAM_limit: A box-conditioned SAM mask remains visible segmentation. It may include an occluder or wrong instance; mask0 is not semantic E/S or virtual-reference absence. Target-class grounding may help identity, but does not produce expected/amodal M0 or solve hidden reference association.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.prototype_limit: TRAIN-only class/prototype parameters are legitimate only from TRAIN and selected with inference-known category; no VAL/current target template or per-test GT-mask-weighted prototype. VAL-only classes6/11 remain unsupported by a supervised TRAIN-only per-class bank.
inference_target_request_and_public_fair.seen_unseen_caution: The new frozen source class breakdown shows V78 covered recall38/217 on TRAIN-seen VAL classes and23/70 on unseen classes. Thus unseen categories alone cannot explain the failure; main VAL covered mass217/287 is seen. This is post-prediction diagnosis only, not category input or selection.

relationship_to_dense_supervision_review: Wait for full V79 same-crop coverage/collision results before choosing any candidate. This identity-request option differs from adding visible/M0 auxiliary loss to the same inputs. Do not combine changes and claim an isolated cause; no backbone sweep is proposed.
not_assessed: SAM3 and other model families were not investigated because this bounded task already has a primary official detector-to-existing-SAM21 path; no availability/performance claim about them is made.

primary_sources.facts: Official IDEA-Research model card lists Transformers zero-shot object detection and Apache-2.0; image plus text yields phrase-conditioned boxes. It recommends lowercase phrases separated by periods.

Processor supports image-text pairs and multiple period-separated classes; grounded postprocessing recovers boxes and text labels in requested image coordinates. Example thresholds are documentation examples, not selected experiment values.
Configuration documents max_text_len256 and disable_custom_kernels. These expose implementation controls; no speed/memory compatibility is certified by reading the config.

IDEA official example loads grounding-dino-tiny through AutoProcessor/AutoModelForZeroShotObjectDetection, sends detected XYXY boxes to SAM2ImagePredictor without positive point prompts, and accepts SAM2.1 checkpoint/config arguments. Demo precision/threshold settings are not an experiment protocol.

The repo documents Python3.10, Torch>=2.3.1, torchvision>=0.18.1,CUDA12.1 and both HF/original GroundingDINO routes; it records SAM2.1 support. Original native GroundingDINO build may require CUDA compilation; no build was attempted.
Original repository supplies Apache2.0 license. The HF card separately labels the tiny weights Apache2.0.
